status.summary: Heavyweight contender, #3 in the UFC media-panel rankings (Nov 3, 2026), booked against Alex Pereira in the five-round co-main event of UFC 335 (Dec 12, 2026, T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas). Dana White announced it on the UFC 332 broadcast (Oct 3, 2026), and UFCalendar and Wikipedia still list it on Nov 6. He is on a three-fight win streak after back-to-back losses to Tom Aspinall (KO R1 1:09, interim title, UFC 295, Nov 11, 2023) and Alexander Volkov (UD, Jun 22, 2024). The wins: unanimous decisions over Jairzinho Rozenstruik (Feb 1, 2025) and Waldo Cortes Acosta (Aug 23, 2025), then a 39-second KO of Tallison Teixeira at UFC Macau (May 30, 2026). Pro record 21-3 (ESPN, UFCalendar, Wikipedia); UFC record 9-3 per ufcstats. No injury was reported in the pages checked on Nov 6, but a Pavlovich-specific injury search could not be completed (search engine rate limit), so injuries are unconfirmed rather than ruled out.

signature: fast first-round blitz of straight punches and hooks to the head: all 7 of his UFC KO/TKO wins came in round 1, five of them inside 2:15 (Teixeira 0:39, Tuivasa 0:54, Lewis 0:55, Golm 1:06, Greene 2:11)
follow-up punches on a dropped opponent (finish of Shamil Abdurakhimov on the ground; 2 knockdowns of Tuivasa in 54 s)
long reach for his height (84 in at 6 ft 3 in) to land from outside
takedowns and top control to see out a decision when the early finish does not come (2 of 2 takedowns and 377 s of control vs Rozenstruik)
weaknesses: knocked out in 69 seconds by Tom Aspinall in his interim title shot (UFC 295), landing 1 of 7
out-pointed at range by Alexander Volkov's length and leg kicks (46-83 in significant strikes, 32 of 42 leg kicks absorbed)
TKO'd by ground strikes after Alistair Overeem took him down in his 2018 UFC debut
very head-heavy: 88% of significant attempts go to the head (decayed) at 39% head accuracy, with little leg or body work
when the early finish does not come his output is modest: 1.7 to 4.1 significant strikes landed per minute in his three decisions (Volkov, Rozenstruik, Cortes Acosta)
style.summary: A heavy-handed southpaw who walks forward and throws in bunches at the head, aiming to finish in the first round, as he did in all seven of his UFC knockouts. Since the Aspinall loss he has added patience and some wrestling to win decisions, but long, mobile strikers who kick the legs (Volkov) have given him problems.

moves.notes: Each group (head, body, leg) sums to 1. From the decayed sums in fighters.json his significant attempts go 88% head, 8% body, 5% legs (landed 77/13/10), and career attempts 90/7/3, so the engine will mostly pick the head group. Inside it, power shots dominate: the rear straight ('cross', his left as a southpaw) 0.32, hook 0.26 and overhand 0.16, because his finishes are punches at distance thrown in flurries; the jab is secondary (0.18) and kicks to the head are near zero (no head-kick finish on record). The body group leans to punches (bodyhook 0.40, bodystraight 0.35) because his kicking volume is low (career 19 leg strike attempts in 12 fights). Leg weights are near neutral (calf 0.55, inside 0.45) on a tiny sample (14 of 15 vs Cortes Acosta). Knee and elbow are token weights: only about 6% of his decayed attempts come in the clinch (2%) or on the ground (4%), 13% career. ufcstats does not record technique types, so the within-group splits are judgment. Sources: data/derived/fighters.json; ufcstats per-fight totals in data/raw (snapshot 2026-10-31).

engine_notes.note: Front-loaded finishing: all 7 UFC KO/TKO wins in round 1 (average about 1:51). Since Nov 2023 he has gone 3 rounds three times (L Volkov, W Rozenstruik, W Cortes Acosta), landing 25 to 61 significant strikes in 15 minutes, with round-3 output at or above round 1 each time (Cortes Acosta 9/22/30, Volkov 15/15/16, Rozenstruik 11/3/11). No pace data beyond round 1 in 5-round fights; rounds 2-5 should lean on the heavyweight prior.
Power: 8 knockdowns in 63.4 UFC minutes, 3.4 per 100 significant head strikes landed career (2.7 decayed).
Chin: 1 knockdown absorbed and 2 KO/TKO losses (Overeem, ground strikes, 2018; Aspinall, punch, 2023) in 12 UFC fights.
Accuracy is low for a knockout artist: 44% of significant strikes overall and 39% to the head (decayed), while he absorbs 3.2 significant strikes per minute against 42% opponent accuracy.
Takedown defense 90% decayed but on tiny numbers (opponents 1 of 4 career). He has a 5-round fight booked (UFC 335) with no 5-round minutes past round 1 in his record.
